Interface RetentionCriteria

All Known Implementing Classes:
PolicyRetentionCriteria
@Internal public interface RetentionCriteria
What DefaultBeanContext.stopRetaining(RetentionCriteria) asks about the singletons of the context it stops, for a development launcher restarting the application: the combined answer of the BeanRetentionPolicy beans, which PolicyRetentionCriteria gives, and of what the launcher knows about the restart.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
graemerocher

  • Method Details

    • retain

      boolean retain(BeanRegistration<?> registration)
      Whether a singleton survives the restart, with what it holds.
      Parameters:
      registration - The singleton's registration
      Returns:
      True to retain it

    • observedConfigurationPrefixes

      Set<String> observedConfigurationPrefixes(BeanRegistration<?> registration)
      The configuration prefixes a change under which releases a singleton this retains, as BeanRetentionPolicy.observedConfigurationPrefixes(BeanRegistration) declares them: a configuration bean under one of them that the singleton holds is not retained with it, nor does it keep it from being retained. A configuration bean of its closure under another prefix is observed instead, by touches(String), so the prefixes only need to cover what the singleton reads outside configuration beans.
      Parameters:
      registration - The retained singleton's registration
      Returns:
      The prefixes, empty when only the configuration beans of its closure release it

    • isReplaced

      default boolean isReplaced(Class<?> type)
      Whether the restart replaces a class, so that a retained bean bound to it would keep the stopped generation of the application reachable and run its old code: a bean whose closure has a definition, an instance or a prototype it owns of such a class is not retained.
      Parameters:
      type - The class of a definition or an instance in the closure of a retained bean
      Returns:
      True when the class is replaced

    • refusedBy

      default @Nullable Object refusedBy(BeanRegistration<?> registration)
      What refuses a singleton, so that it is not retained whatever retain(BeanRegistration) answers for it, nor is a singleton that holds it: a BeanRetentionPolicy that refuses it. It is asked about every singleton of the closure of a bean retained, and the log names it by its class.
      Parameters:
      registration - The singleton's registration
      Returns:
      What refuses it, or null when nothing does

    • touches

      default boolean touches(String prefix)
      Whether the change behind the restart touched configuration at or under the prefix. A retained singleton is released when a configuration bean in its closure, under a prefix that observedConfigurationPrefixes(BeanRegistration) does not cover, is under a touched prefix: the singleton was made from that configuration, which the next context binds again. It is asked about the prefix of each such configuration bean, the entry's own for an EachProperty entry.
      Parameters:
      prefix - The prefix of a configuration bean in the closure of a retained singleton
      Returns:
      True when the change touched it
